facts.business: Solvex Edibles Limited is engaged in the manufacturing, distribution, marketing and sale of solvent-extracted rice bran oil and related by-products including de-oiled rice bran, rice bran, mustard oil, mustard cakes and de-oiled mustard cakes, primarily supplying to FMCG companies and cattle-feed, poultry-feed and fish-feed segments.

capacity_or_capex.item: IPO funds for acquisition of Plant and Machinery

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management expects operational improvements and disciplined execution to support sustainable growth over the medium term

auditor.name: ARORA GUPTA & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on: (a) IPO fund utilization for plant & machinery advance of Rs 140 lakhs to supplier simultaneously received back in subsidiary LLP Golden Pearl Oil Products LLP, and Rs 590 lakhs credited to CC account then reused for general purposes; (b) Non-recognition of employee benefit obligations for gratuity and leave encashment per AS 15; (c) Non-recognition of interest payable to MSMEs per AS 29.
